en.headline: CHP confirms another mpox case as yearly total reaches 26
en.dek: A 25-year-old man is in stable condition after testing positive; health authorities again urge high-risk groups to get vaccinated amid a rise since August.
body: The Centre for Health Protection of the Department of Health said on Saturday that it is investigating a confirmed mpox case involving a 25-year-old man who remains in stable condition under isolation at Queen Elizabeth Hospital.

The patient developed intermittent fever from 2 September and later developed lymphadenopathy and a rash affecting the genital area, groin, face and eyelids. He sought treatment at Pamela Youde Nethersole Eastern Hospital and Queen Elizabeth Hospital on 15 and 17 September respectively before being admitted for isolation. Laboratory testing confirmed the presence of the monkeypox virus.

According to the patient, he had multiple high-risk exposures in Hong Kong during the incubation period. No epidemiological links have been identified so far with earlier confirmed cases. The centre is continuing its investigation and will report the case to the World Health Organization.

As of Saturday, Hong Kong has recorded 26 mpox cases this year, comprising 21 local and five imported cases. Seventeen of the cases have been reported since August. All of the recent patients reported sexual activity with men, and most described high-risk behaviour including sex with strangers or without condoms. Ten of the recent cases involved the use of dating apps.

The centre again urged people who have engaged in high-risk sexual contact to remain vigilant, seek medical attention promptly if symptoms appear, and consider vaccination. An mpox hotline (2125 2373) operates daily from 9am to 6pm to provide advice.

zh.headline: 衞生防護中心再確診一宗猴痘個案 本年累計26宗
zh.dek: 25歲男子情況穩定，當局再呼籲高風險群組接種疫苗；八月以來新增17宗個案。
body: 衞生署衞生防護中心今日（9月19日）表示，正調查一宗猴痘確診個案，患者為一名25歲男子，現於伊利沙伯醫院接受隔離治療，情況穩定。
患者自9月2日起間歇發燒，其後出現淋巴結腫大，並於生殖器官、腹股溝、面部及眼瞼出現皮疹。他分別於9月15日及17日到東區尤德夫人那打素醫院及伊利沙伯醫院求診，其後入住隔離。經中心公共衞生化驗服務處化驗後，樣本對猴痘病毒呈陽性反應。
根據患者提供的資料，他於潛伏期內在香港有多次高風險接觸。中心至今未發現此個案與本港早前錄得的猴痘個案有流行病學關連，會繼續調查，並向世界衞生組織通報。
截至今日，本港本年累計錄得26宗猴痘個案，包括21宗本地個案及五宗輸入個案，其中17宗為八月以來新增。近期個案患者均報稱有男男性接觸行為，大部分涉及與陌生人發生性行為或未有使用安全套，其中十宗個案患者曾使用約會應用程式。
中心再呼籲曾有高風險性接觸的人士保持警惕，出現相關病徵應盡快求醫，並考慮接種疫苗。猴痘熱線2125 2373每日上午9時至下午6時提供健康評估及建議。
